systems.country_label: نظام المعلومات للإصلاح الإداري وإدارة التعليم «سراج» (Siraj; SIRAGE in French)
systems.platform: said to need no internet and to run over the ordinary telephone network
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Reform of the Education System
systems.tiers: regional education officials, trained by field missions sent out on 27 April 2025, which also update and collect incomplete data on educational institutions; parent access promised 'soon'

note: No fact: the dispatch says the platform will give up-to-date, permanent data in place of quarterly reports, and that missions are completing data on institutions, but not that schools enter a record per learner, so Siraj is unclassified here. It gives no count of schools; the access for parents to information on their children's schooling is announced, not in service.
